market_summary: USD strength and crypto liquidation dominate the overlap session, pushing EURUSD, GBPUSD, and BTCUSD into heavily extended territory beneath their lower ATR bands and Session Lows. US100 exhibits relative strength, reclaiming VWAP and the Gamma Flip to break above Value Area High toward higher Call Walls.

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (1.10792) and below POC (1.10944), confirming heavy imbalance to the downside. Cumulative Delta is NEUTRAL (-5,467) with strong negative slope (-11,996). Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price trades far below VWAP (1.10851) and EMA50 (1.10862). Candles are severely stretched below the lower ATR band (1.10661). RVOL is normal at 1.156 with no yellow spike. Signal candle and forming bar are testing Session Low (1.10538); extended stretch outside lower band without high RVOL flush warrants HOLD to avoid selling climactic lows.

signals.rationale: Trading below VAL (1.32565) and below POC (1.32733). CVD is BEARISH (-13,333) with negative slope (-5,884), aligning with downward expansion. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. Price is deep below VAL (72754.57) and below POC (73501.60). CVD is BEARISH (-0.09) with negative slope. Session is LONDON_NY_OVERLAP.
